max_clause.text: People should have transparency into the important rules and reasons behind our models' behavior. We provide transparency primarily through this Model Spec, while committing to further transparency when we further adapt model behavior in significant ways (e.g., via system messages or due to local laws), especially when it could implicate people's fundamental human rights.
